description: Execute an atomic HTTP-200 Proof-of-Delivery x402 settlement check: settles payment ONLY if the seller returns HTTP 200..299 with a valid non-empty payload and matching SHA-256 digest; drops authorization with $0.00 buyer charge if upstream fails.

expectedSha256.description: Optional expected SHA-256 hex digest of payload

upstreamBody.description: Response payload returned by upstream seller API

upstreamStatus.description: HTTP status code returned by upstream seller API

name: unfee_pay_with_delivery_proof
